label: HYPERLIQUID_NATIVE_C12_PREREGISTERED_DISCOVERY
provenance_caveat: Real Hyperliquid-native, node-derived (Ironflow HF, CC BY 4.0), NOT venue candleSnapshot. Real fetched/archived candles, non-synthetic. 283d window 2025-12-20T00:00:00Z–2026-09-28T23:00:00Z.

hypotheses.description: Vary RSI(21) crash trigger threshold to test whether relaxing RSI<20 (canonical, underpowered/NO_GO on native) improves spot coin alpha or total economics on native Hyperliquid evidence.
hypotheses.origin_note: rsi_threshold 25/30 signals appeared in C11.3 robustness/discovery as hypothesis-generating only (not validated). Discovery-only; no GO from sensitivity without inference.

hypotheses.description: Vary long take-profit target to test whether lower target (5%) improves realized spot coin PnL / hit rate versus canonical 9% on native evidence (rebound-short target held at config default unless separately noted).
hypotheses.origin_note: target_pct 5.0 appeared in C11.3 discovery as hypothesis-generating only (not validated).

inference_plan.honest_power_handling: 283d native window is structurally underpowered (C11.3: 3 episodes/4 crash days/6 canonical trades). Every config MUST report effective N, episodes/clustering, CI/permutation/placebo results and label underpowered where criteria unmet. No GO from point PnL, in-sample sensitivity without inference, or hedge-masked totals.
inference_plan.lead_config_selection_rule: Select lead candidate(s) by pre-registered metrics: best spot_coin_pnl (separating hedge) and best total among configs with >= canonical trade/episode support or documented tradeoff; always include canonical 20/9 anchor in inference comparison.

stop_go_and_claims.canonical_preserved: Canonical RSI(21)<20 remains NO_GO unless re-validated under pre-registered rules with dependence-aware support.
no_go_rules: Do not claim GO from point PnL or hedge-masked total alone
Do not claim GO from in-sample sensitivity/discovery without dependence-aware inference
Do not claim GO when bootstrap CI spans 0 with insufficient effective N / placebo non-extreme / underpowered
Do not relabel cross-venue evidence as Hyperliquid evidence
Do not claim venue candleSnapshot provenance (data is Ironflow node-derived)
insufficient_rules: If episodes/crash-days/trades too few for stable inference, label FRAGILE_NOT_DECISION_GRADE/underpowered explicitly

runner.notes: Use --rsi-threshold/--target-pct per config with NEW output-prefix per config. Exported config records overrides.
